_about: Games kept off the site's listings for good. Every generator filters these slugs out of games-index.json, the homepage, category pages, all-games, collections, hubs and similar-games lists; seo_cleanup.py keeps their game page noindex and out of sitemap.xml. The game page itself stays live. Remove a slug here (and re-add it to games-index.json) to bring a game back.
